sloka: रावणं त्वब्रवीन्मन्त्री प्रहस्तो (प्रहसो) नाम वारुणः ।गतः खलु महाराजो ब्रह्मलोकं जलेश्वरः ।। ७.२३.५१ ॥
transliteration: rāvaṇaṁ tvabravīnmantrī prahasto (prahaso) nāma vāruṇaḥ ।gataḥ khalu mahārājo brahmalokaṁ jaleśvaraḥ ।। 7.23.51 ॥

translations.english: Then a minister of Varuna named Prahasta (or Prahasa) said to Ravana, "Indeed, the great king, the lord of waters Varuna, has gone to the world of Brahma."
